scope: Voice eligibility for report server/owner delivery and initial combined-arms/ground fallback dispatch
finding: Existing voice checks used horizontal separation, allowing a radio-less overhead/stacked-surface receiver to qualify despite large actual height difference.
implementation: ReportLocal uses ASL anchor positions and vectorDistance for voice; ReportServer/CombinedArmsServer/GroundFallback compare ASL3D separation within the existing horizontal voice prefilter. Radio gates, discovery envelope, dual-radio requirements, original observations and finite dispatch budgets remain unchanged.
non_changes: Reports deliberately carry area/confidence/time without target object; do not add identity or native reveal to infer ignored-target mapping.
No hidden enemy transforms, acoustic raycasts or radio propagation model.
No active operation cancellation merely because communication is lost after receipt.
Air fallback and other support communication paths retain their existing policy; not universal communication parity.
bounds: No new world scan, receiver fanout or worker. One sender ASL sample per server opportunity and candidate ASL reads only on near-horizontal voice checks; receiver owner reuses ASL positions for existing horizontal range gate. Cost unmeasured.
remaining: Altitude/floor/jamming and voice-only versus dual-radio live cases
Delayed receiver delivery after position/radio changes
